open_question: Opens with a question that gets a {run}-second answer with no other question in between.
open_setup: Opens with a lead-in before a short question, then a {run}-second answer.
open_story: Opens with a story or anecdote marker, so viewers step right into it.
open_contrast: Opens with a contrast or identity statement (not … but …).
open_reveal: Opens with a confession or reveal marker (honestly, it turns out, actually).
open_number: Opens with a concrete number or amount of money.
open_cold_open: The first line of the video, a good opener (cold open).
open_plain: Starts at a clean sentence boundary.
teaser_echo: The line is also used in the video’s opening teaser (picked by the channel’s editor).
end_laugh: Ends right after laughter or applause, so the payoff is complete.
end_recap: Ends with a concluding line (so, finally, that’s why).
end_pause: Ends at the end of a sentence with a {gap, number, ::.0}-second pause.
end_question: Note: ends on a question; the answer is outside the clip.
laughs: {count, plural, one {# laugh} other {# laughs}} in the clip.
silence: Relaxed pace: silence ratio of {ratio, number, ::percent}, above the episode average.
penalty_teaser: Penalty: overlaps the opening teaser (repeated cut).
penalty_sponsor: Penalty: contains an ad or sponsor (promo, voucher code, discount).
penalty_segue: Penalty: contains a segment transition mid-clip.
penalty_outro: Penalty: contains the sign-off at the end of the video.
penalty_greeting: Penalty: opens with the channel greeting.
penalty_suspect: Penalty: contains a doubtful part of the transcript (broken ASR).
penalty_fillers: Light penalty: far more filler words than the episode average.
penalty_dense_laughs: Dense laughter in a short chat is capped (often a trap).
similar_topic: Topic is similar to a higher clip; its score was lowered.
cold_open: Cold open: the hook line ({seconds, number, ::.0} s) plays first.
focus_fill: From the heuristic: mentions the focus you asked for, in a part of the video the LLM did not pick.
heuristic_fill: Heuristic filler because the LLM found too few moments.

warning.media_probe_failed: The video length could not be read.
warning.subtitle_rejected: {detail, select, invalid {The .srt subtitles could not be read} empty {The .srt subtitles have no words} duration_mismatch {The .srt subtitles are longer than the video} other {The .srt subtitles were not used}}; the transcript was made from the audio.
warning.captions_missing: No YouTube subtitles; the transcript was made from the audio.
warning.captions_rejected: YouTube subtitles not used ({detail}); the transcript was made from the audio.
warning.groq_fallback: Groq was not used ({detail, select, no_key {no Groq API key yet} auth {Groq refused the API key} rate_limited {the free Groq quota is used up} too_long {the video is over 2 hours, past the free Groq hourly limit} too_large {the audio file is over the Groq size limit} audio_failed {the video audio could not be prepared} model_unavailable {the Whisper model on Groq is unavailable} server_error {the Groq server has a problem} http_error {Groq refused the request} timeout {Groq did not answer in time} network {this server cannot reach Groq} malformed {the Groq answer could not be read} empty {Groq found no speech} other {an unexpected error}}); the transcript was made with Whisper on this server.
warning.no_word_timestamps: The transcript has no per-word timing.
warning.punctuation_collapse: Transcript punctuation is missing in part of the video.
warning.suspect_segments: {count, plural, one {# doubtful transcript part} other {# doubtful transcript parts}}.
warning.audio_unavailable: Audio analysis unavailable; clip edges come from the transcript only.
warning.trend_context_invalid: The job trend file is broken or missing; the job ran without trends.
warning.trend_items_skipped: {count, plural, one {# broken trend item skipped} other {# broken trend items skipped}}.
warning.llm_unavailable: AI (LLM) unavailable ({detail}); clips picked with local heuristics.
warning.llm_disabled: AI (LLM) is turned off; clips picked with local heuristics.
warning.llm_not_configured: AI (LLM) is not set up; clips picked with local heuristics.
warning.llm_failed: AI (LLM) failed ({detail}); clips picked with local heuristics.
warning.llm_chunked: {count, plural, one {The transcript was sent to the AI in # part.} other {The transcript was sent to the AI in # parts.}}
warning.llm_dropped: {count, plural, one {# AI moment discarded} other {# AI moments discarded}} ({detail}).
warning.llm_no_moments: The AI answer had no moments ({detail}).
warning.llm_retry: {count, plural, one {The AI was asked once more ({mode}) and added # moment.} other {The AI was asked once more ({mode}) and added # moments.}}
warning.llm_filled: {count, plural, one {# clip filled from the heuristic because the AI found too few moments.} other {# clips filled from the heuristic because the AI found too few moments.}}
warning.snap_dropped: {count, plural, one {# moment discarded because it did not fit the sentence edges.} other {# moments discarded because they did not fit the sentence edges.}}
warning.trend_ref_ungrounded: {count, plural, one {# trend named by the AI was dropped because the clip transcript does not mention it.} other {# trends named by the AI were dropped because the clip transcripts do not mention them.}}
warning.trend_packaging_ungrounded: {count, plural, one {# AI clip named a trend its transcript does not mention; its title, hook or description was rebuilt from the clip itself.} other {# AI clips named a trend their transcript does not mention; their titles, hooks or descriptions were rebuilt from the clips themselves.}}
warning.trend_sensitive_humor: {count, plural, one {# funny clip touches a sensitive trend; check its title and hook before posting.} other {# funny clips touch a sensitive trend; check their titles and hooks before posting.}}
warning.focus_terms_unmatchable: {count, plural, one {# focus keyword is too short or too common to search the transcript for directly; for it only the AI reading counts.} other {# focus keywords are too short or too common to search the transcript for directly; for them only the AI reading counts.}}
warning.focus_literal_ungrounded: {count, plural, one {# clip the AI said names the focus does not contain the term in its transcript; its label was lowered from “Mentions”.} other {# clips the AI said name the focus do not contain the term in their transcripts; their labels were lowered from “Mentions”.}}
warning.focus_packaging_ungrounded: {count, plural, one {# clip used a focus keyword in its title, hook or description without saying it; that text was rebuilt from the clip itself.} other {# clips used a focus keyword in their titles, hooks or descriptions without saying it; that text was rebuilt from the clips themselves.}}
warning.focus_few_matches: {count, plural, =0 {No moment matches the focus; every clip is another best moment, labeled “Outside focus”.} one {Only # clip matches the focus; the other slots hold other best moments, labeled “Outside focus”.} other {Only # clips match the focus; the other slots hold other best moments, labeled “Outside focus”.}}
warning.focus_topup: {count, plural, =0 {The AI was asked once more for moments around uncovered focus mentions, but found no further focus moment worth using.} one {The AI was asked once more for moments around uncovered focus mentions and proposed # more focus moment.} other {The AI was asked once more for moments around uncovered focus mentions and proposed # more focus moments.}}
warning.focus_topup_failed: The extra AI request for focus moments failed ({detail}); clips were picked from the first AI proposal.
warning.focus_topup_skipped: {detail, select, budget {The extra AI request for focus moments was skipped: the remaining AI requests went to the rerank, or the job AI request limit was reached.} deadline {The extra AI request for focus moments was skipped because the job AI time limit ran out.} context {The extra AI request for focus moments was skipped because its transcript part does not fit the model context.} other {The extra AI request for focus moments was skipped.}}
warning.few_clips: {count, plural, one {Only # usable clip was found.} other {Only # usable clips were found.}}
warning.clip_trimmed_to_media: Clip {clip} was trimmed so it does not run past the end of the video.
warning.cold_open_beyond_media: The cold open of clip {clip} runs past the end of the video and was skipped.
warning.clip_beyond_media: Clip {clip} runs past the end of the video.
warning.llm_providers: {count, plural, one {# AI provider answered.} other {# AI providers answered.}}
warning.llm_models: {count, plural, one {# AI model answered.} other {# AI models answered.}}
warning.engine_fallback: Clip {clip} was rendered the fallback way.
warning.thumbnail_failed: The cover image of clip {clip} could not be made.
